title: Computer-mediated communication and gamification as principal characteristics of sustainable higher education: empirical evidence and theoretical frameworks
reason: Largely theoretical paper with two case studies measured only by feedback forms, questionnaires and surveys (teachers and students). No platform-recorded indicator or activity product is related to success or a construct; all data are self-report.

extraction.design: mixed (theoretical overview + case studies with surveys)
extraction.population: university teachers and students (several small samples: 30 teachers, 23 students, 18 seminar participants, 46 respondents in the motivation table)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported motivation level, attitudes to video games and e-learning tools
extraction.notes: Only percentages from questionnaires (e.g. 39.2% high motivation). Authors note the questionnaire's reliability still needs testing. Secondary: E1 arguably.
